"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Solidarity with comrades around the globe is essential to begin undoing the bloody effects of endless wars, austerity, colonial exploitation, environmental destruction, stolen land, and other atrocities that make up the legacy of US actions in service of capital.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"As socialists living in the heart of the American empire, DSA must oppose imperialism and work to address, cease, and heal the harm caused by the ruling class.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Only by listening to and aligning with those directly targeted by policies can DSA begin to work toward a unified global vision of socialism and international working class solidarity.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for standing in solidarity with labor, workers’ and socialist movements across the globe and popular movements against austerity, militarization, and repression.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Support for labor rights for all, regardless of immigration status, and inclusion of farm workers, street vendors, day laborers, and domestic workers under National Labor Relations Board legal protections.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Support for building an anti-war movement that opposes US intervention, including sanctions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
